description: Khaya AI is a Ghanaian language-technology product that grew out of the GhanaNLP open-source initiative; its developer APIs are licensed under an Algorine Research EULA. It sells translation, automatic speech recognition and text-to-speech APIs focused on Ghanaian and other African languages such as Twi, Ga, Ewe, Dagbani, Hausa and Yoruba, through monthly per-call plans with a free developer tier.
name: Khaya AI (GhanaNLP)
